title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Narasimhudu
desc: A young orphaned boy is adopted by the villagers and grows up striving for their wellbeing. When the sons of two corrupt men rape an 11-year-old, the young man vows to punish them for the crime.

title: Madhura Raja
desc: Raja, a lion-hearted don, heads to the village of Pambinthurthu to protect people from a local criminal and illegal liquor merchant, Nadeshan, who terrorises them.

title: Karthikeya 2
desc: The movie deals with the personal problems of Karthik and how he comes out of them. His pursuit of the truth leads him to find out the power of ancient Indian system and Tatva of Lord Sri Krishna.

title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.

title: Surya The Soldier
desc: When a soldier lands in trouble due to his anger issues, he begins seeing a psychologist in hopes of one day returning to duty.
